summary: Take a lattice u of R; the row clauses give the spanning, the scalar elements and the inertia conditions above g; conjugate self-duality relates u at g and at (g^c)⁻¹; the local length at ℓ is bounded by the rank of the crystalline cocycles, at the places above g by the inertia orders, and the determinant terms by cr_ℓ.

steps.claim: For all large O: the lattices of R span and have a scalar element (span_and_scalar), and a lattice u of R exists (eventually_exists_isLatticeIn).
steps.lean: filter_upwards [r.span_and_scalar, eventually_exists_isLatticeIn r.continuous] with O hs ⟨u, hu⟩

steps.claim: Unpack: spanning; g, l, α with cyc(g) = g_l^{|n|} and u(g) = α·1; the algebra map F of exists_algHom; n nonempty; the finite set S of bad places off ℓ; 1 ≤ |n| ≤ r; the negative jump count bound; a scalar inertia element g₀ with R(g₀) = y·1 and the unit conditions on y.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨hs, g, l, α, c, hg⟩, ⟨Φ, I, f, d⟩, ⟨i⟩, S, ⟨⟨a, b⟩⟩, h2, g₀, o, y, q, hy⟩ := hs u hu,
    hu.exists_algHom, card_pos_iff.1 r.2.1.1, Set.union_sdiff_left ▸ h.sdiff, r.2,
    sum_mono r.card_neg_le, r.5

steps.claim: y lies in O (an entry of u(g₀)).
steps.lean: cases by simpa [q] using congr($(hu.choose_spec g₀) i i)

steps.claim: u(g₀) = y·1 (F injective).
steps.lean: replace q : u _ = u _ .. • 1 := I (by simpa [f])

steps.claim: y^j − 1 is a unit of O for 1 ≤ j ≤ 4|n| + 2.
steps.lean: have Y j h := (O.isUnit_iff_norm_eq_one (_ ^ j - 1)).2 (by simpa using hy 0 j h)

steps.claim: At each place v above g and not above ℓ choose γ_v, N_v and the inertia facts of the row (inertia_above_g).
steps.lean: choose! γ m Z F G H using (r.inertia_above_g · · (FinPlace.isPlaceOver_placeOver _))

steps.claim: Transport through F.
steps.lean: simp_rw [← f, ← map_one Φ, ← map_sub, d, ← S.mem_toFinset] at *

steps.claim: At each place above ℓ: the jumps and the class of the local lattice (inClass_of_isLatticeIn).
steps.lean: choose L K using (inClass_of_isLatticeIn · r.1 r hu)

steps.claim: If u(g) = y·1 then y is a unit and u((g^c)⁻¹) = cycInv(g⁻¹)^{t−1}·y·1: by the trace identity of the row (conjugate self-duality) and spanning, traces determine the element.
steps.lean:
have C {g y} (e : u g = y • 1) : IsUnit y ∧ u (conjGal g)⁻¹ = (cycInv ℓ _ O g⁻¹ ^ (t - 1) * y) •
    1 := ⟨by simpa [e, Nat.ne_of_gt a] using isUnits_det_units (u.toHomUnits g), (by exact fun _ _ ↦
    ext_iff_trace_mul_left.2 ∘ DFunLike.ext_iff.1 : (traceLinearMap .. ∘ₗ mulRight O ·).Injective)
    (ext_on_range hs fun k ↦ by ext; simp [cycInv,
    e, by simpa [↓← hu.trace_eq] using
    And.intro (r.trace_conj (conjGal k * g⁻¹)) (r.trace_conj (conjGal k))]; ring)⟩
steps.typed_fact:
IsUnit y ∧ u (conjGal g)⁻¹ = (cycInv ℓ _ O g⁻¹ ^ (t - 1) * y) •
    1

steps.claim: u, γ = g₀, β and the clauses of IsBalanced.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨u, _, _, hu, ?_, (isOpen_discrete · |>.preimage ((hu.continuous r.continuous).matrix_map
    continuous_quot_mk)), fun _ ↦ hu.eq_one ∘ r.eq_one_of_mem_inertiaAbove _ ∘ by simp, hs,
    ⟨by simpa, _, ⟨by simp [C q, cycInv, cycChar_eq_one_of_mem_inertiaAbove (o.imp fun _ ↦
    .imp_left (·.2))], q⟩, by simpa [sq, mul_self_sub_one] using Y 2⟩, orderOf_le_card.trans_lt' (by
    simpa using (Y _ ⟨((C q).1.map (residue O)).isOfFinOrder.orderOf_pos, ·⟩ |>.map (residue O))),
    fun x b ↦ Quotient.induction_on_pi b fun b ↦ by simpa [obeying_crysRels, entrywise] using! (fun
    v _ ↦ comp_mem_obeying (Z := ZfAt _ u) _ (crysCocycles.coboundary_mem b)), _, _, _,
    ⟨hg, (C hg).2⟩, fun x hx ↦ by
    grw [iInf_le _ ⟨_, FinPlace.isPlaceOver_placeOver _⟩,
      (by simp [← Finset.coe_inj] : h.toFinset = (placesDividing _
      ℓ).toFinset ∪ S.toFinset), sum_union (by simp [Finset.disjoint_right]), ← sum_set_coe]
    refine .trans (add_le_add_three (sum_le_sum fun v _ ↦ .trans (length_mono (by
     rintro _ ⟨_, h, ⟨⟩⟩; simp [mem_selmerModule_iff, obeying_crysRels] at h; tauto))
      (length_obeying_relationsOn_le (crysCocycles.fg (K _).isPotCrys) i)) (sum_le_sum fun v
      c ↦ have p := v.isPlaceOver_placeOver.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff.2 (S.mem_toFinset.1 c).2
      length_localCocycles_le (nsmul_quot_eq_zero hx) v.isPlaceOver_placeOver (hu.eq_one ∘ G v c ·)
        (((r.local_conditions v (·.1) v.isPlaceOver_placeOver).1.1
        p).mono fun _ ↦ (hu.eq_one ∘ ·)) (γ v) (by simp [*])) le_rfl) ?_
    simp_rw [← sum_mul, finrank_crysCocycles_eq_add_neg_jumps (localChart ..).inducesPlace.2
      (K _).isPotCrys (L _), ← Nat.cast_sum, sum_add_distrib]
    simp [NumberField.Embeddings.card, finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace, ← two_mul, mul_assoc,
      star_involutive.bijective.sum_comp (J · |>.countP (· < 0))] at h2
    grw [sum_complexEmbOf_le, h2, length_ker_le_addVal_det, ← add_assoc, add_assoc]
    gcongr; simp [Finset.disjoint_right]; ring; rfl⟩

steps.claim: u mod ℓ^M is locally constant (u continuous); u(g) = 1 on the inertia off the bad places (eq_one_of_mem_inertiaAbove); spanning.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨u, _, _, hu, ?_, (isOpen_discrete · |>.preimage ((hu.continuous r.continuous).matrix_map
    continuous_quot_mk)), fun _ ↦ hu.eq_one ∘ r.eq_one_of_mem_inertiaAbove _ ∘ by simp, hs,

steps.claim: Scalar inertia: g₀ in inertia above S off ℓ with u(g₀) = y·1 = u((g₀^c)⁻¹) (step 9, cyc(g₀) = 1), y ± 1 units (step 5); the residue field has more than 4|n| + 2 elements (the residue of y has large order).
steps.lean:
⟨by simpa, _, ⟨by simp [C q, cycInv, cycChar_eq_one_of_mem_inertiaAbove (o.imp fun _ ↦
    .imp_left (·.2))], q⟩, by simpa [sq, mul_self_sub_one] using Y 2⟩, orderOf_le_card.trans_lt' (by
    simpa using (Y _ ⟨((C q).1.map (residue O)).isOfFinOrder.orderOf_pos, ·⟩ |>.map (residue O))),

steps.claim: Coboundaries obey crysRels u (crystalline coboundaries: crysCocycles.coboundary_mem, obeying_crysRels); the scalar pair (g, α, α') with step 9.
steps.lean:
fun x b ↦ Quotient.induction_on_pi b fun b ↦ by simpa [obeying_crysRels, entrywise] using! (fun
    v _ ↦ comp_mem_obeying (Z := ZfAt _ u) _ (crysCocycles.coboundary_mem b)), _, _, _,
    ⟨hg, (C hg).2⟩, fun x hx ↦ by

steps.claim: Local length: split the sum over the bad places into those above ℓ and those of S.
steps.lean:
grw [iInf_le _ ⟨_, FinPlace.isPlaceOver_placeOver _⟩,
      (by simp [← Finset.coe_inj] : h.toFinset = (placesDividing _
      ℓ).toFinset ∪ S.toFinset), sum_union (by simp [Finset.disjoint_right]), ← sum_set_coe]

steps.claim: Above ℓ: the local cocycles obeying crysRels have length ≤ that of obeying the relations of Z_f, bounded by the rank of Z_f (length_obeying_relationsOn_le); at v ∈ S: the local cocycle length is bounded by length_localCocycles_le (u is trivial on the inertia powers and near 1).
steps.lean:
refine .trans (add_le_add_three (sum_le_sum fun v _ ↦ .trans (length_mono (by
     rintro _ ⟨_, h, ⟨⟩⟩; simp [mem_selmerModule_iff, obeying_crysRels] at h; tauto))
      (length_obeying_relationsOn_le (crysCocycles.fg (K _).isPotCrys) i)) (sum_le_sum fun v
      c ↦ have p := v.isPlaceOver_placeOver.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff.2 (S.mem_toFinset.1 c).2
      length_localCocycles_le (nsmul_quot_eq_zero hx) v.isPlaceOver_placeOver (hu.eq_one ∘ G v c ·)
        (((r.local_conditions v (·.1) v.isPlaceOver_placeOver).1.1
        p).mono fun _ ↦ (hu.eq_one ∘ ·)) (γ v) (by simp [*])) le_rfl) ?_

steps.claim: The rank of Z_f at each place above ℓ is rk + #negative jumps (finrank_crysCocycles_eq_add_neg_jumps).
steps.lean:
simp_rw [← sum_mul, finrank_crysCocycles_eq_add_neg_jumps (localChart ..).inducesPlace.2
      (K _).isPotCrys (L _), ← Nat.cast_sum, sum_add_distrib]

steps.claim: Count embeddings: the number of complex embeddings is [E : ℚ] = 2·(number of infinite places), and h2 (at most |n| negative jumps at σ and σ̄ together) becomes a bound for the sum over all embeddings.
steps.lean:
simp [NumberField.Embeddings.card, finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace, ← two_mul, mul_assoc,
      star_involutive.bijective.sum_comp (J · |>.countP (· < 0))] at h2

steps.claim: Sum over the places above ℓ is ≤ the sum over all embeddings (sum_complexEmbOf_le); the scalar term by v(det) (length_ker_le_addVal_det).
steps.lean: grw [sum_complexEmbOf_le, h2, length_ker_le_addVal_det, ← add_assoc, add_assoc]

steps.claim: Arithmetic.
steps.lean: gcongr; simp [Finset.disjoint_right]; ring; rfl⟩

steps.claim: The remaining determinant bound at the chosen w, where γ_w is the tame generator (step 6).
steps.lean: simp [-univ_bool, ← Z w hℓ hG]

steps.claim: Each v(det(u(γ_b) − 1)) ≤ |n|·cr_ℓ (inertia_above_g), the number of places above g is ≤ 4f (card_le_of_subset_placesAboveG), and the scalar term v(α − cyc(g^c)α') is bounded by v(g_l^{|n|(t−1)+…} − 1) ≤ cr_ℓ (ellVal_le_crudeUnit).
steps.lean:
grw [H w hℓ, sum_le_sum (by exact (H · · true)), sum_const, card_le_of_subset_placesAboveG,
    ellVal_le_ellVal, ellVal_le_crudeUnit D ℓ l ⟨mul_pos a (t - 1).succ_pos,
    mul_le_mul' b (D.t_odd.rec (by omega))⟩] <;> simp [← add_mul, cycInv, c, ← mul_assoc, pow_succ',
    ← one_sub_mul, pow_mul, norm_sub_rev, (O.isUnit_iff_norm_eq_one _).1 (C hg).1]

steps.claim: Arithmetic: the total is ≤ 10·f·|n|·cr_ℓ.
steps.lean: gcongr; norm_cast; nlinarith [D.f.pos_of_neZero]
